correctness.rationale: For g=f^k, C(X)=g^{-1}(g(X)) is fiber saturation and I(X)=X∩im(g). A mixed fiber gives a singleton separating the composites; saturated image suffices for all X. For a nonpermutation with maximum tail height h, whenever 2k>h a transient vertex u at depth d≤k with d+k>h is outside im(g) but its g-image is a cycle point also reached from im(g); hence failure. The one-ended chain f(i)=min(i+1,n-1) has disjoint g-images of its image and complement when 2k≤n-1, proving sharp K_n=ceil(n/2). Rank-k enumeration bijects to two surjections on complementary image subsets. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all maps through six states matched totals 1,2,12,108,1100,13350. Finite enumeration supports, but does not replace, the argument.
